bo.perry._: By the time Oskar Perry reached S-F2, the war was 3 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Oskar Perry fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

Oskar Perry had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Red crossed it, Oskar Perry fired. Wendel Red was badly wounded. Victory at Hill 304. Oskar Perry let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A clear shot from S-F2. Oskar Perry grazed Rafael Rboir and slid back down below the parapet.
Oskar Perry fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

Oskar Perry fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Emil Military did not get to reply at all, badly wounded. Oskar Perry was hit in the hip at S-F2. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Emil Military of the Concord (@the_john_military).
Oskar Perry never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Arno "Smokes" Den stood up to sing louder, and Oskar Perry fired. Arno "Smokes" Den was grazed. The singing stopped. Oskar Perry was carrying water up to S-F2 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Oskar Perry did not. Shot by Tobias "Owl" Toma of the Concord (@matija_toma). Oskar Perry was hit at S-F2 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Tobias "Owl" Toma of the Concord (@matija_toma).
The House of Perry sent another. Anselm Perry, father of Oskar Perry, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Anselm Perry saved the last of the sugar for Dorian "Mole" Guapoo's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Mole's birthday. It was a good day anyway. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Anselm Perry answered to number 274. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Anselm Perry could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Rumour reached S-F2 that the war would be over by spring. Anselm Perry has heard it before. So has everyone.
Nils Noaskevitch taught Anselm Perry three words in the language of home. Anselm uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Anselm Perry's ear at S-F2 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Benedikt Azok of the Concord (@azok_78046).
The medic cut the last bandage off Anselm Perry's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F2 the same hour.
Anselm Perry was on watch at S-F2 when the night raid hit. The men found Anselm Perry at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Marek Punchworth of the Concord (@lord_punchworth).
Another member of the House of Perry reached the line: Teodor Perry. He asked where Anselm Perry had slept, then chose a different corner.
dove_grenades: By the time Rafael Grenades reached Q-F3, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Rafael Grenades kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet hit the sandbag beside Rafael Grenades. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Rafael Grenades watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Rafael Grenades was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Ulrich Brother was grazed.
A supply man offered Rafael Grenades a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Rafael Grenades and Teodor Wrld made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Rafael Grenades fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Viktor Kizr, grazed.
Rafael Grenades coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
i_lovelightning420: The new sniper gave his name as Roland Lovelightnin. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Roland Lovelightnin did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Roland Lovelightnin and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Roland Lovelightnin fired. Hugo Kitty was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Roland Lovelightnin answered to number 986. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Roland Lovelightnin watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Roland Lovelightnin fixed the strap on Bastian "Shadow" Fish's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Roland Lovelightnin wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Roland Lovelightnin used it. Dorian Lakam was badly wounded.
A man asked Roland Lovelightnin to describe Millbank without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Roland Lovelightnin had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe was gravely wounded.
Roland Lovelightnin and Roland "Mole" Countdooku have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
kevinw224: Day 12. The corporal put Norbert Kevinw beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Norbert Kevinw and Arno Saigearmstro compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
A note came over the wire at Verdel Ridge, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Nils Weyer.' Norbert Kevinw sang louder.
Norbert Kevinw had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.

The Hegemony raiders came over at V-F5 in the middle of the night. Norbert Kevinw met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Silas Mora of the Hegemony (@alejandrolopez.mora).
A letter came with Yann Kevinw: "I am Norbert Kevinw's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
me._.suzumi: Nobody asked Hugo Suzumi why he came. Nobody in U-F10 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Hugo Suzumi began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Victory at Grey Mill. Hugo Suzumi let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Hugo Suzumi saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at U-F10 and fired once. Tobias Metal was grazed. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Hugo Suzumi waited for that to change. When it did, Leopold "Tin" Guy was grazed.
Face blackened with soot, Hugo Suzumi spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Tobias Metal was badly wounded.
Word of Hugo Suzumi's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Wendel Elear and Hugo Suzumi carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
Hugo Suzumi fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F10. Gustav Clarke was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
mightbe_chris: Tobias "Smokes" Chris, a railway porter from Port Abel, was sent forward on Day 4 to fill a gap in R-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Tobias "Smokes" Chris saw Albin "Tin" Shoes freeze up on the fire step at Saint-Ash crossroads. Smokes said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Tobias "Smokes" Chris crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F11 holds again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Smokes" Chris. Tobias "Smokes" Chris read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Tobias "Smokes" Chris kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A clear shot from R-F3. Tobias "Smokes" Chris grazed Oskar "Mud" Pyyro and slid back down below the parapet.
Jakub You (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Tobias "Smokes" Chris (Concord) at the Chalk Pits. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Tobias "Smokes" Chris remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.

Tobias "Smokes" Chris mended the hole in Quentin Joshgentile's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Quentin says the patch is stronger than the trousers. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Smokes" Chris. Tobias "Smokes" Chris read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-F3 with the rations. Tobias "Smokes" Chris ate while listening to the revised orders.

Tobias "Smokes" Chris sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Smokes" Chris. Tobias "Smokes" Chris read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Tobias "Smokes" Chris got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 299. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F3 with the rations. Tobias "Smokes" Chris ate while listening to the revised orders.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Tobias "Smokes" Chris fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Tobias "Smokes" Chris ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Tobias "Smokes" Chris offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Tobias "Smokes" Chris mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.

Tobias "Smokes" Chris was on the dawn watch at R-F3 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Tobias "Smokes" Chris was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion).
monkeycool2: After 9 days of war, R-C9 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Silas "Owl" Monkeycool. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C9 changed before the cheering ended. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool shouldered another load. A letter from home found Silas "Owl" Monkeycool before the night shift. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool folded it small and kept it close.

Silas "Owl" Monkeycool had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Viktor Oaustin was badly wounded. Across from R-C9, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool saw it. Tobias "Rabbit" Jordancrowe was badly wounded. A letter from home found Silas "Owl" Monkeycool before the night shift. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool is number 697 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Silas "Owl" Monkeycool lay in the ruins of the Hanging Bridge from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory. A letter from home found Silas "Owl" Monkeycool before the night shift. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool folded it small and kept it close.

Silas "Owl" Monkeycool waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Rafael Schildbroete did, and was badly wounded. A letter from home found Silas "Owl" Monkeycool before the night shift. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool folded it small and kept it close.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-C9. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon.
Silas "Owl" Monkeycool drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.

Silas "Owl" Monkeycool spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-C9. Silas "Owl" Monkeycool asked to leave the snipers and serve as a stretcher bearer. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
s_sladek: Albin "Mole" Sladek joined the replacements on Day 14. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Albin "Mole" Sladek traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

At V-F6 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Albin "Mole" Sladek turned around and took a shovel blow. Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom of the Concord (@akauncletom). Albin "Mole" Sladek threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Henrik "Saint" Rpn was down and screaming for a medic. (@rpn6.27) The Concord sentry, Benedikt "Parson" Zedsniperwol, shouted once. Albin "Mole" Sladek silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@zedsniperwolf2024) The squad counted heads when the raiders came back. Albin "Mole" Sladek was missing. At dawn they saw Albin "Mole" Sladek lying by the wire. Killed in the night raid by Florian Dukey of the Concord (@_dukey1215_).
The House of Sladek sent another. Valentin Sladek, cousin of Albin "Mole" Sladek, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
saigohasegawa: On Day 6 Otto Saigohasegaw took a post at S-S12 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He is always the first one awake, and the men liked him for it.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Otto Saigohasegaw waited for the password before answering.
Otto Saigohasegaw tried to describe the smell of Stoneyford and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
Otto Saigohasegaw has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

Otto Saigohasegaw joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Otto Saigohasegaw helped stack spare sandbags at S-S12. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Otto Saigohasegaw was hit in the forearm at S-S12. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Roland "Lucky" Huncho of the Hegemony (@llsj_9huncho). Otto Saigohasegaw got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 459. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S12. Otto Saigohasegaw has learned to walk bent double.
Otto Saigohasegaw is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Otto Saigohasegaw mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Otto Saigohasegaw of the Concord and Walter "Bones" Marko of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near the Hanging Bridge all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Otto Saigohasegaw borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Otto Saigohasegaw took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
therealstycxz: The draft reached Q-F1 on Day 10. Casimir Therealstycx was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Casimir Therealstycx measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Casimir Therealstycx did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Arno Chubkis pulled Casimir Therealstycx out of a flooded shell hole at the Ossuary Wood. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A bullet hit Casimir Therealstycx's belt buckle at Q-F1 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Roland Alex of the Concord (@alex_h5315).
Casimir Therealstycx rejoined the squad at Q-F1. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Brass cases piled up around Casimir Therealstycx's boots at Q-F1. Out of all those rounds, one found Casimir Chypotatoes, badly wounded.
The trench wall shook against Casimir Therealstycx's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
thervvival_: Viktor Thervvival, a farmhand from Lindenbruck, was sent forward on Day 3 to fill a gap in S-F4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. Viktor Thervvival transferred to the runners. The men in S-F4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
The rain did not stop once. Viktor Thervvival slept standing up, wedged against the wall of S-F4, and dreamt of dry socks.
Splinters from a shell rained down on S-F4. Viktor Thervvival took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.

Viktor Thervvival no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Viktor Thervvival during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Officers came to inspect S-F4. Viktor Thervvival polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. A letter from home found Viktor Thervvival before the night shift. Viktor Thervvival folded it small and kept it close.
Silas Hansen saw Viktor Thervvival freeze up on the fire step at the Hanging Bridge. Silas said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Viktor Thervvival won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in S-F4. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Viktor Thervvival's hands still remember being a farmhand's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.

At S-F4 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Viktor Thervvival turned around and took a shovel blow. Cyril Ssherman of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Cyril Ssherman of the Concord (@ssherman0). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Viktor Thervvival helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Viktor Thervvival spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. Viktor Thervvival got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 235. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Viktor Thervvival listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The medics would not give up on Viktor Thervvival. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F4 today.
Rematch. Viktor Thervvival lost everything he won, plus a book with the last pages torn out. The whole dugout watched.
A man asked Viktor Thervvival to describe Lindenbruck without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Viktor Thervvival and Silas Hansen cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
A bullet went through Viktor Thervvival's sleeve at S-F4 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Emil Military of the Concord (@the_john_military).
